# science/tests/fixtures/

**SYNTHETIC test data only. NOT NASA data. NOT for analysis.**

Every file in this directory is generated by a script in `science/tests/fixtures/`
and used only to exercise code paths deterministically in pytest. No file here
is ingested into the shipped product and no number computed from these fixtures
is ever shown in the UI.

- `make_synthetic_ndvi.py` — regenerates the NetCDF fixture below. Deterministic.
- `synthetic_ndvi.nc` — tiny NetCDF mimicking the post-ingest MOD13C2 structure.
